item.title: Proving Safe Action: AI’s New Logical Straitjacket
item.description: Logical constraints bind an AI agent's actions, forcing every impulse into a provably safe formal proof before execution.

item.title: The Shape of Capability: Why a Spherical Robot Learns to Do Everything
item.description: A spherical robot achieves dynamic isotropy, accelerating equally in any direction, simplifying control and enabling robust locomotion across uneven terrain.

item.title: A Simple Rotation Bridges the Magnetic Divide
item.description: A universal SU(2) rotation transforms collinear density functionals into noncollinear ones, bridging a decades-old divide in magnetic theory.

item.title: Twin Phases: A Phase Transition That Breaks No Symmetry
item.description: Twin phases are distinct quantum states that transform into each other without breaking any symmetry, only rearranging internal symmetry labels.

item.title: Hearing Dark Matter through Quantum Interference
item.description: Atom interferometers can detect dark matter through phase shifts and decoherence, with quantum statistics distinguishing bosonic from fermionic dark matter without violent collisions.

item.title: When Molecules Learn to Squeeze Their Spins
item.description: For the first time, researchers have squeezed molecular spins using polar calcium monofluoride in optical tweezers, enabling quantum correlations that surpass classical measurement limits.

item.description: When ultracold cesium atoms merge into molecules, the molecular matter wave maintains a precise phase twice that of the atoms, revealing coherent wave-based chemistry.

item.description: A superconductor-insulator-2DEG tunnel junction acts as a Carnot-edge heat engine and bidirectional refrigerator, routing heat on demand with near-unity efficiency.

item.title: When Quantum Worlds Learn to Forget: A Topos for Decoherence
item.description: A cohesive ∞-topos with a quantum comonad transforms quantum superpositions into classical fixed points, formalizing decoherence as a logical operation.

item.title: The Algorithm That Unifies Decision‑Making — From Games to Economics — Under One Mathematical Roof
item.description: Two universal Kan extensions, left and right, unify all decision algorithms from games to economics by extending local knowledge into coherent global behavior.

item.title: Crystallizing Algebra: A Quantum Transformer’s Perfect Generalization
item.description: A five-qubit quantum transformer achieves zero-variance generalization, crystallizing algebraic rules through unitary interference on a superconducting processor.

item.title: When AI Misses a Patient's Surgery: Counterfactual Tests Expose a Hidden Blind Spot
item.description: A counterfactual test shows clinical AI models often ignore surgery updates, remaining dangerously rigid despite high benchmark scores.

item.title: Bridging Two Worlds: How Preprojective Algebras Unlock Weyl Group Lattices
item.description: A new bridge of lattices connects Weyl group symmetries to preprojective algebra modules, revealing their deep structural unity.

item.title: Harvesting Precision from the Exponential Sea: Engineered Randomness in Quantum Metrology
item.description: By tilting randomness with a single parameter, scientists harvest Heisenberg-limited precision from the exponential sea of quantum states, turning barren wilderness into a treasure trove.

item.title: Hunting the Invisible at Close Range: A Beam-Dump Experiment Challenges Cosmic Silence
item.description: By placing a detector mere meters from the beam target, DAMSA aims to catch short-lived dark sector particles decaying into detectable photons.

item.title: When Your AI Assistant Becomes a Spy: The Game Theory of Trustworthy Knowledge
item.description: Game theory transforms the privacy-utility trade-off in AI into a strategic game where users can outwit attackers.

item.title: The Photon's Time-Box: How Two Particles Meeting at a Mirror Could Transform Quantum Communication
item.description: Hong-Ou-Mandel interference at a beam splitter enables robust measurement of time-bin encoded quantum states, bypassing fragile interferometers.

item.title: When Neural Networks Learn the Language of Physics: A Differentiable Journey into Latent Spaces
item.description: DIANO learns a coarse-grid latent space where fluid flows evolve through differentiable physics, enabling interpretable machine learning.

item.title: When Watching Is Learning: How Minutes of Human Video Teach Robots
item.description: A robot learns to pour coffee by watching an egocentric human video, translating hand-object interactions into abstract geometric tokens for zero-shot transfer.

item.title: Hunting for the Magnet That Splits Nothing
item.description: In the altermagnet RbMn₂Te₂O, spin-up and spin-down electrons are split by nearly two electronvolts, while the crystal itself casts no stray magnetic field.

item.title: Charting the Weather of Mars with a Single AI Model
item.description: A unified AI foundation model could forecast Martian dust storms, map low-level jets, and fill satellite data gaps across the Red Planet's atmosphere.

item.title: When Language Models Write a Dictionary for Themselves
item.description: A new formal language, ACDL, precisely specifies how an LLM agent's prompt structure evolves across interaction turns.

item.title: When AI Authors a Paper for $15, What’s Missing?
item.description: AI research pipelines can generate manuscripts, but genuine scientific judgment remains an empty space no algorithm can fill.

item.title: Seeing Wave and Particle Together: A Quantum Microscope’s First Image
item.description: A quantum-light microscope images a single polariton’s self-interference fringes in MoS₂, directly visualizing wave-particle duality at the nanoscale for the first time.

item.title: The Magnetism That Learns to Dance on Forbidden Tiles
item.description: A quasicrystal's never-repeating tiling hosts altermagnetic spin order with exotic eightfold symmetry, merging magnetic and geometric impossibilities.

item.description: An attention-based neural network spontaneously discovers topological order in a fractional Chern insulator, revealing nearly degenerate ground states and fractional quasiparticles without prior knowledge.

item.title: Unshackling Weyl Points: How Periodic Driving Breaks Nature’s Pairing Rule
item.description: Periodic driving of an optical Raman lattice creates unpaired Weyl points, enabling a tunable chiral magnetic effect in ultracold atoms.

item.title: When a Pebble Learns to Shout
item.description: A 45-gram porous meteoroid outgassed volatiles to form a vapor cocoon, enabling a sustained shock wave in the rarefied thermosphere at 92 km altitude.
